description:
Create a new Java Maven project named 'gs-maven' in IntelliJ IDEA at ~/IdeaProjects/gs-maven/. The project should:

1. Use groupId 'org.springframework' and artifactId 'gs-maven'
2. Include a 'hello' package with two classes: HelloWorld (main class) and Greeter
3. Use the joda-time library to display the current time
4. The Greeter class should have a method that returns a greeting message
5. The project should compile successfully
